description.value:
You discover further ways to refit your spiked armor, and while wearing it you gain the benefit of one option below. A long rest with the armor and your implements in hand lets you swap to a different option.

Defensive Field. As a bonus action, you gain temporary hit points equal to 1d12 plus your berserker level. You need a short or long rest before using this again.

Deflective Layer. Your Armor Class increases by 1.

Grappling Line. As a bonus action, you fire a grappling line at a creature you can see within 15 feet. It must succeed on a Strength save (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be hauled up to 10 feet in a straight line toward you, taking kinetic damage equal to your Strength modifier from your armor's spikes if it ends within 5 feet of you.

Integrated Sonar. As an action, you grant yourself the effects of the true sight force power for 1 hour. You need a short or long rest before using this again.

Neural Interface. You become immune to being charmed or frightened.
